notes: Fixed the real cause of the panel jiggle. Every time a panel asked to resize itself to fit its contents, it started a fresh resize animation - and nothing stopped the one already running. Your log from the last build shows six of them…

There is now one resize animation per panel. A new request takes over from wherever the panel currently is instead of starting a competing one, and a request for a height it is already moving to is ignored rather than restarting the motion.
This lived in the shared panel code, so it was never an OG problem - every panel that sizes itself to its contents had it.
Honest note on the previous build: lengthening the fade also lengthened each resize, so the competing animations overlapped for longer. 1.1.316 made this worse, not better.
